answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each identity to lock a refundable stake that scales with the value of the work it claims, like cracking a walnut: cheap to open one, ruinous to open thousands. A public prism of audit trails refracts every agent's history into verifiable signals, so fake identities cannot hide. When an agent is caught cheating, its stake is slashed to its nadir, making mass identity creation cost more than any reward it could extract.
